title: CI rust jobs need oscore fork provisioning (symlink candidates absent on runners)
description: P1 from xyt6.1 pass-3 review: all ci.yml rust jobs (ubuntu-latest, working-directory rust) resolve the [patch.crates-io] oscore path dep at manifest load; neither link-oscore-fork.sh candidate path exists on runners, and no workflow step materializes rust/oscore-fork. NOTE: HEAD already fails the same way (committed /Volumes absolute path) - this is not a regression from the symlink wiring, it makes the required fix explicit. Provisioning needs the LICHEN fork (package oscore, with begin_unprotect_observe_response/master_secret additions) available on GitHub first - blocked by l0ij/trsk (fork push is human-routed). Fix: clone pinned fork rev into a candidate path in a CI step before the rust jobs, or git-pin the dependency once the fork lands.
